Antigravity 开着的话不用关。如果它这次启动时没带调试端口参数，安装程序会问你，回车后关掉它，装完再带参数打开。 6. 以后请从开始菜单、桌面或任务栏的图标打开 Antigravity。安装程序给这些快捷方式加了启动参数。 **macOS** 1. 安装 Antigravity，并登录一次。 2. 下载并解压安装包。打开“终端”，输入 `bash` 和一个空格，把 `一键安装.command` 拖进终端窗口，按回车。 3. 安装中会问两件事：Antigravity 没带调试端口参数启动时要不要自动重开（推荐回车，选自动重开）；要不要用作者的配色。 装好以后，插件的面板在 Antigravity 右上角的“插件”菜单里，名字是“agy-zh”。想换配色：运行 `配色开关`。卸载：运行 `一键卸载`。请保留解压出来的文件夹。 ## 默认状态 | 功能 | 默认 [没带调试端口参数时](#没带调试端口参数时) | 缩放、字体、对比度一律不改。 ## 功能 ### 界面汉化 菜单、设置、按钮、提示文字换成中文（3469 条词典 + 111 条正则规则）。对话内容、代码、文件名不翻译。几句话拼成的说明（比如模型菜单里“说明 + 下线日期”），整段在词典里查不到时，按句号拆开逐句翻，每一句都翻得出来才换成中文（v2.0.7 起）。v2.0.8 起，Antigravity 自带的 Swarm 面板（单独的插件框架）也汉化：标签页、状态、计数、筛选这些界面文字翻成中文，智能体写的目标、任务标题、消息保持原文。 有些东西刻意不翻： - **Antigravity 自己的功能名**：Artifact、Turbo、Coordinator、Swarm 保留英文（例如“Turbo 模式”“Artifact Plan（可能是“套餐”，也可能是“计划”）、Type、Space，保持英文。 - **报错信息**照常翻成中文，鼠标停在上面会显示英文原文，方便搜索和向官方反馈。 #### 临时切回英文 v2.0.8 起，按 `Ctrl+Alt+E`（macOS 是 `Ctrl+Option+E`）整页恢复英文，再按一次切回中文，方便对照官方文档。所有窗口和 Swarm 面板一起切；刷新后恢复中文，不改设置。插件面板“运行状态”一节也有“现在切换”按钮。AltGr+E（有的欧洲键盘用来打 €）不算。 #### 没翻译的界面文字 v2.0.7 起，汉化查不到译文的界面文字会记在数据目录的 `i18n-missing.json` 里。插件面板的“没翻译的界面文字”一节显示条数，可以展开看最近 30 条，也可以清空。 - 这个文件只在本机，不上传。 - 2.15B tok (rough) · resets 11-29 09:41 · est 45% at reset (rough)`）： - `cap ≈`：这一周（重置时间往前 7 天到重置时间）本机的折算花费和 token，除以这一周的已用比例，估出整周额度大约相当于多少钱、多少 token。v2.0.5 起，周期开始那天只算周期开始以后的调用（按每次调用的时间；后台算好之前先按整天算）。 - `est … at reset`：照最近的用量速度，到重置时大约会用到多少；照这个速度会提前用完的，改成 `full` 加预计用完的时间。速度取这一周的平均和最近 24 小时（至少有 6 小时的读数）两种。额度读数存在 `quota-samples.json`，保留 8 天。 - 两个数都标 `(rough)`：已用比例本身会来回起伏，刚开始一周、用得很少时误差很大。悬停看算法和剩余额度。 - 以前的周期（v2.0.6 起）：每次换周期（自然到期或提前重置），插件记下周期的起止时间和结束前用了多少；悬停时列出最近 4 个周期各自的花费和 cap（花费按每次调用的时间算）。攒几个周期以后，cap 明显变小，就说明额度可能被收紧了。v2.0.6 以前只记了提前重置的那几次。 每周额度按每个周期的净变化算：当天最后看到的已用比例，减去当天开始时的已用比例；当天换了周期，就分段相加。原因是已用比例在同一个周期里会来回起伏（实测正在生成时，6 分钟里从 1.699% 降到 1.594%），v1.4.x 只累计上涨的部分，会把回落后的再上涨重复算进去，当天用量偏高。v1.5.0 升级后会自动按新方法重算以前的每周额度记录。v2.0.4 起每个周期单独记一段：额度被重置时，读数偶尔会跳回旧周期一次（2026-11-24 实测），这时接着旧周期那段算，不再把旧周期的用量当成新周期又算一遍（那天原来记成 14.84%，实际 7.06%）。升级后会用 `quota-samples.json` 里的读数，把读数覆盖整天的日子重算一次。 - Antigravity 没开着时用掉的额度（比如用 agy CLI），会算到下次观察到的那一天。 - 额度是按账号算的。如果这个号开了 Google 家庭组共享，或者在别的电脑上也在用，额度里会包含别人的用量。这时 `cap ≈` 会偏低（别人的用量涨了额度，却没有算进本机的花费），`est` 会偏高。 装上以后，插件会补算以前的天数，只补一次：只读打开 Antigravity 自己的对话库（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\conversations\*.db`，macOS 是 `~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/*.db`），读出每次调用的时间、模型和 token 数，按日期归到每一天，钱按状态栏的单价表算。补算的天没有额度记录（以前没人记过）。每次调用按它自己的时间归日。v1.5.x 按“这一轮开始的时间”归日，跑过 0 点的一轮会整轮记到前一天（实测一天少记了 349 次调用）；v1.6 起升级后会自动重算一次以前补算的天数。补算用到 Node.js 内置的 `node:sqlite`，插件用的是 Antigravity 自带的 Node（24.x），满足要求。补算用的是 Antigravity 内部的存储格式，它改了格式就补不出来，不影响其他功能。v2.0.5 起历史留 Windows：给 Antigravity 的快捷方式加启动参数。macOS：问 Antigravity 没带参数启动时要不要自动重开。 6. 问要不要用作者的配色（默认不用）。 **数据目录**是 `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-zh-pack`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\plugin_data\agy-zh-pack`）。插件更新时插件目录会整个换掉，数据放在外面，不受影响。里面有：`cost-day.json`（今天的花费）、`usage-history.json`（每天的用量）、`quota-samples.json`（额度读数）、`cli-index.json`（每个 agy CLI 对话库在哪几天有调用）、`i18n-missing.json`（没翻译的界面文字）、`look.json`（状态栏外观和在线更新开关）、`settings.json`（没带参数启动时的处理方式）、`originals.json`（配色原值）、`remote/`（在线更新下载到的文件）、`inject.log`（日志）、`relaunch.log`（重开的记录）。数据文件读不出来时（比如写坏了），会改名成 `<名字>.bad-年月日时分.json` 留着，不会被新数据覆盖。文件被别的程序短暂占着（比如杀毒软件正在扫）时，先重试几次；还读不出来，这一次先不用它、也不保存，下次再读，不会用空数据盖掉原文件（v2.0.11 起；以前会当成没有这个文件，下次保存时把它盖掉）。 不改缩放、字体、对比度。配色只在你选择“作者的配色”时才改。 ## 卸载 运行 `一键卸载`（Windows 双击 `一键卸载.cmd`；macOS 在终端里用 `bash` 运行 `一键卸载.command`）： - 去掉快捷方式上的启动参数，删掉插件目录。Antigravity 开着时会在几秒内停掉插件；刷新一下窗口就变回英文。 - 用过作者的配色的，会问要不要恢复成原来的颜色（要先关闭 Antigravity，改完再打开）。 - Antigravity 关着时，顺便删掉它的设置文件里给本插件记的条目。 - 最后问要不要连数据目录一起删。选保留的话，以后重装还能接着用以前的每日记录。 - 插件目录被占着删不掉时（很少见），会提示你关掉 Antigravity 以后手动删。 请保留解压出来的文件夹，卸载、切换配色时都要用。

**Windows**：安装程序给开始菜单、桌面、任务栏上的 Antigravity 快捷方式加上 `--remote-debugging-port=0`（`0` = 随机端口），卸载时去掉。只改目标是 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\antigravity\Antigravity.exe` 的快捷方式。Antigravity 自动更新后可能重写快捷方式，插件发现端口没开时，每 2 分钟检查一次，把参数补回去。 - **macOS**：从程序坞或启动台打开 Antigravity 时总是不带参数。 - **这次启动没带参数时**：插件约 20 秒后发现，按面板里“没带调试端口启动时”的设置处理： - **询问**（Windows 默认）：弹框问要不要现在重启 Antigravity。点“确定”就重启，点“取消”这次就不再问。 - **自动重开**（macOS 安装时推荐）：不问，直接重启。 - **不处理**：什么都不做，界面保持英文。 - 询问或重开之前，插件先查正在运行的 Antigravity 是怎么启动的。确实没带参数才询问或重开；带了参数、只是端口一时连不上（例如电脑很忙），插件不处理，只在日志里记一行。v2.0.0 没有这一步，会误重启带了参数的 Antigravity，v2.0.1 修好了。 - 重启的做法：先正常关闭 Antigravity，几秒内没退出就强制结束，再带参数打开。对话记录会保留，正在运行的任务会被打断。实测从关闭到重新注入约 6 秒。重新打开时只带调试端口参数：你自己在快捷方式上加的其他启动参数这次不会带上。 - 本项目只改本机的界面显示，状态栏只读取本机数据，不改发给 Google 的内容。 - 插件由 Antigravity 在后台启动，用 Antigravity 自带的 Node 运行，约占 80～120 MB 内存。 - 在线更新会从本项目的 GitHub 仓库下载词典和价格表。万一仓库被人篡改，界面上可能出现被改过的文字（不会执行代码，也拿不到你的数据）。介意的话在插件面板里把在线更新关掉。 - 启动参数会在本机 `127.0.0.1` 打开一个调试端口（2.33.0 以前的 Antigravity 本来就默认打开）。本机上的其他程序可以通过这个端口控制 Antigravity 窗口。介意的话请不要使用本项目。 ## 安装程序做了什么 安装脚本用 Antigravity 自带的 Node 运行（Windows 的 `Antigravity.exe`、macOS 的 `Antigravity Helper`），不用另装 Node.js。 1. 核对安装包：按 `plugin-manifest.json` 校验作者签名和每个文件的 sha256，对不上就不装。 2. Antigravity 开着但这次没带调试端口参数：问过你以后先关掉它，装完再带参数打开。 3. 从 v1.x 迁移：停掉旧的注入程序，删掉开机自启（Windows 的计划任务 `AgyZhPack` 和“启动”文件夹里的脚本，macOS 的 LaunchAgent），把每日记录、外观、额度读数、配色原值、`style.css` 搬到数据目录，删掉 Windows 上旧的安装目录 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AgyZhPack`。macOS 上从源码运行的旧版，源码文件夹不动。 4. 把插件复制到**插件目录** `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-zh-pack`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-zh-pack`）。Antigravity 开着时几秒内会自动启动插件（macOS 实测）；没有启动的话，重启一次 Antigravity。 5. Antigravity 要带 `--remote-debugging-port=0` 启动。Windows 先运行一次 `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File debug-port.ps1` 给快捷方式加上参数；macOS 运行 `./macos/launch-agy.command`（或 `open -a Antigravity --args --remote-debugging-port=0`），见 [macos/README.md](macos/README.md)。 - 改了 `statusbar.js` 或 `i18n` 下的文件后，已打开的窗口会自动更新，不用重启。改了 `inject.mjs` 要重启注入程序。 - 想给页面加自己的样式（比如换回复字体），在数据目录（从源码运行时是 `inject.mjs` 同一个文件夹）放一个 `style.css`，注入程序会自动加载；没有这个文件就不改任何样式。 - 改了 `i18n/translator.js` 的逻辑，要把里面的 `VERSION` 加 1，已打开的窗口才会换用新翻译器。 - 发版前，开着 Antigravity 运行 `node tools/dev/probe.mjs all`：经调试端口打开插件面板、状态栏、每日用量面板和当天的调用明细，读出界面上的文字和悬停说明，每项写 OK / WARN / FAIL。单元测试只管函数算得对不对，这里看功能在真的 Antigravity 里有没有显示出来。另有 `missing`（列出记下的没翻译的文字）、`calls <日子>`、`miss`、`ckpt`、`english`、`swarm`、`eval` 等命令，`node tools/dev/probe.mjs help` 看全部。加 `--shot <目录>` 顺便截图；加 `--ssh <主机>` 在另一台 macOS 上跑（把脚本复制过去，用 Antigravity 自带的 Node 运行，截图拷回来）。除了 `check`、`update`、`english`，命令都只读。 - Antigravity 升级以后，开着 Antigravity 运行 `node tools/find-ui-strings.mjs`，找新出现的界面文字。结果在 `dist/ui-strings.md`，标 NEW 的是上一次没有的。提取是按规则猜的，会混进代码里的字符串，要人工挑出界面文字再翻。 - 如果注入程序在 Antigravity 打开很久以后才启动，状态栏会提示 `Press Ctrl+R to reload this window`，按一次 Ctrl+R 刷新窗口就好。 **测试**：`node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"`（需要 Node.js 22.13 以上，读 CLI 库的测试用到 `node:sqlite`）。测试数据都是写在测试里的合成数据，不读本机的用量记录和对话库。每次推送，GitHub Actions 也会跑一遍（`.github/workflows/test.yml`）。`inject.mjs` 和 `statusbar.js` 不是模块，测试按标记截出其中的函数；改了这些函数附近的代码，测试会提示要跟着改。 **发版**（需要作者的签名私钥）：先改好代码和 README（中英文），新文件先 `git add`，写好提交说明和发布说明，再运行 ``` node tools/publish.mjs <版本> --title "" --notes <发布说明.md> --message <提交说明.txt> ``` 脚本按顺序做下面几步，任何一步失败就停下，说明停在哪一步；查明原因后加 `--from <步骤>` 接着做。发版前可以先加 `--check`，只检查条件、跑测试，不改文件。 1. `test`：跑测试。 2. `bump`：把 `plugin.json` 的 `version` 和 `inject.mjs` 的 `PACK_VERSION` 改成新版本。 3. `sign`：`node tools/release.mjs sign`，按 `tools/plugin-files.mjs` 的清单生成并签名 `plugin-manifest.json`。 4. `build`：`node package/build.mjs`，核对签名清单，生成 `dist/agy-zh/` 和同名 zip，再复制成英文名 `agy-zh-pack-v<版本>.zip`（GitHub 会去掉文件名里的中文）。 5. `commit`：提交（包括 `plugin-manifest.json`），打标签 `v<版本>`，按标签里的文件核对签名清单。一键更新从 jsDelivr 的 `@v<版本>` 取文件，所以标签里必须有签好名的清单。 6. `push`：推送 main 和标签。 7. `release`：在 GitHub Releases 发布，上传 zip，下载回来核对 sha256。 8. `meta`：把 `data/meta.json` 的 `latest`、`date` 改成新版本，推到 main。装着旧版本的用户这时才会看到新版本提示，所以这一步放在最后。 开始前脚本还会检查：在 main 分支上；本地 main 不落后于 GitHub（价格表工作流每天可能往 main 推提交，落后时先 `git pull --rebase`）；没有未跟踪的新文件；标签还不存在。 私钥用 Windows DPAPI 加密存在作者电脑上（`tools/release.mjs keygen` 生成）。`node tools/release.mjs export <文件>` 备份成只有当前账号能读的文件，`node tools/release.mjs import <文件>` 在重装系统或换电脑后恢复。私钥丢了就签不了新版本，已安装的插件也收不到更新。
文件说明 | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `plugin.json` | 插件的名字、版本、图标 | | `sidecars/core/sidecar.json` | sidecar 的启动方式（Antigravity 自带的 Node）和侧边栏面板 | | `sidecars/core/main.mjs` | sidecar 入口：设好数据目录，启动注入程序、面板、重开检查；插件文件被换掉时自动重启 | | `lib/panel.mjs` | 插件面板（网页和接口） | | `lib/relaunch.mjs` | 没带调试端口启动时询问或自动重开 | | `lib/update.mjs` | 版本更新：校验签名、下载、备份、替换；作者的公钥在这里 | | `lib/remote-source.mjs` | 在线更新从哪个地址、按哪个提交下载（先问 GitHub 最新提交；问不到就用 meta.json 最新的地址） | | `plugin-manifest.json` | 签名清单：版本、每个插件文件的 sha256 和大小、Ed25519 签名 | | `assets/logo.svg` | 插件图标 | | `inject.mjs` | 注入程序：连 Antigravity 的调试端口，注入下面几个文件；保存今天花费的账本；在线更新 | | `debug-port.ps1` | 给 Windows 上的 Antigravity 快捷方式加、去启动参数 `--remote-debugging-port=0` | | `statusbar.js` | 用量状态栏和费用估算（在页面里运行） | | `i18n/translator.js` | 翻译器（在页面里运行） | | `i18n/zh-CN.json` | 词典：界面英文原文 → 中文 | | `i18n/zh-CN.rules.json` | 正则规则：相对时间、思考时长、下线日期等带数字的文字 | | `data/prices.json` | 在线价格表（GitHub Actions 每天按官方价格页更新） | | `data/meta.json` | 最新版本号（发版时改） | | `tools/plugin-files.mjs` | 插件包含哪些文件（签名、打包、安装都按它） | | `tools/release.mjs` | 发版签名：生成钥匙、签名、校验、备份和恢复私钥 | | `tools/dev/probe.mjs` | 验收探针：经调试端口打开面板、读界面文字和悬停说明、截图、调插件面板的接口（查版本、检查和安装更新），可以经 ssh 在另一台 macOS 上跑；不进安装包 | | `tools/find-ui-strings.mjs` | 找还没有译文的界面文字：从运行中的 Antigravity 取前端脚本、读自带插件的源码，和词典比对，结果写进 `dist/ui-strings.md` | | `tools/publish.mjs` | 一条命令发版：测试、改版本号、签名、打包、提交打标签、推送、建 Release、改 `data/meta.json` | | `tools/update-prices.mjs` | 按官方价格页更新 `data/prices.json` | | `.github/workflows/update-prices.yml` | 每天跑一次上面的脚本：价格变了就提交，出了问题就开 issue | | `.github/workflows/purge-cdn.yml` | 推送了词典或 `data/` 以后，清掉 jsDelivr 上的缓存 | | `.github/workflows/test.yml` | 每次推送都跑一遍 `tests/` 里的测试 | | `tests/` | 测试：额度算法、读写数据文件、读 CLI 库、翻译器、数据文件、语法和版本号 | | `package/app/setup.mjs` | 一键安装、卸载、配色开关 | | `package/build.mjs` | 生成安装包 | | `macos/` | 从源码运行时的 macOS 脚本（v1.x 的方式）；装插件请用安装包 | | `assets/statusbar.png`、`assets/panel.png` | 本页的截图 | 数据目录里的文件见 [安装程序做了什么](#安装程序做了什么)。
## 致谢 - 状态栏的外观和英文写法借鉴 Haleclipse（哈雷）的 [CCometixLine](https://github.com/Haleclipse/CCometixLine)（ccline）的 cometix 主题；v1.5.0 的外观分层（配色、外形、进度条、详略）和上下文圆环参考 ccline v2。感谢哈雷做出这么好看的状态栏。 - 5 小时和每周额度的显示方式参考 agyline。 - 默认配色 Cometix 以 [Catppuccin](https://catppuccin.com)（浅色 Latte，深色 Mocha）为底。其他配色的色值取自各方案公开的定义：Catppuccin、[Tokyo Night](https://github.com/folke/tokyonight.nvim)、[Rosé Pine](https://rosepinetheme.com)、[Gruvbox](https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox)、[Nord](https://www.nordtheme.com)、[Dracula](https://draculatheme.com)（浅色是官方的 Alucard）。 - 图标：Material Symbols 和插件图标用的 Material Icons “translate”（Apache License 2.0）。模型的备选图标（彗星）是 [Font Awesome Free](https://fontawesome.com) 6.7.2 的 meteor，许可 [CC BY 4.0](https://fontawesome.com/license/free)，版权 Fonticons, Inc.。 ## 许可 本项目代码使用 MIT 许可，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 Antigravity 是 Google 的产品。词典 `zh-CN.json` 的键是 Antigravity 的界面英文原文，用于匹配要翻译的文字。

# agy-zh [简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md) **An unofficial Simplified Chinese plugin for Antigravity Desktop (Windows / macOS)** Chinese UI translation · usage status bar above the input box · optional color theme · signed one-click updates [![Download](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ncdeng/agy-zh-pack?label=download&color=D97757)](https://github.com/ncdeng/agy-zh-pack/releases/latest) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ncdeng/agy-zh-pack)](LICENSE) ![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078D6) ![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS-555555) ![The usage status bar above the input box](assets/statusbar.png) Real screenshot: a long conversation
> [!WARNING] > This is a third-party project. It has no connection with Google. By default it only changes what you see on your own computer and only reads local data. Read [Risks](#risks) before you install. > [!IMPORTANT] > **From v2.0, agy-zh is an Antigravity plugin (v1.x was called "中文美化包").** If you installed v1.x, download the v2.0 package and run `一键安装` (install) once. Your daily records and look settings from the old version are moved over, and the old autostart is removed. After that, when a new version is out, click "更新" (update) in the plugin panel; you do not need to download the package again. Tested with Antigravity 2.34.0. > [!NOTE] > This pack is made for Chinese users. It translates the Antigravity UI into Simplified Chinese. The status bar text is in English, but its hover tooltips, the plugin panel, the installer prompts and the file names in the download are in Chinese. If you only want the status bar, see [Status bar only](#status-bar-only-no-translation). ## Quick start **Windows** 1. Install Antigravity and sign in once. 2. Download the latest `agy-zh-pack-v.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/ncdeng/agy-zh-pack/releases/latest). Extract it to any folder. Do not run it from inside the zip. 3. Double-click `一键安装.cmd` (install). If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info", then click "Run anyway". 4. The installer asks one optional question: use the author's color theme. If you are not sure, press Enter (the answer is "no"). 5. You do not need to close Antigravity. If Antigravity was started without the debugging port flag this time, the installer asks you; after Enter it closes Antigravity and opens it again with the flag when the install is done. 6. From now on, open Antigravity from the Start menu, desktop or taskbar icon. The installer added a start flag to these shortcuts. **macOS** 1. Install Antigravity and sign in once. 2. Download and extract the package. Open Terminal, type `bash` and a space, drag `一键安装.command` (install) into the Terminal window, and press Enter. 3. The installer asks two questions: whether to reopen Antigravity automatically when it starts without the debugging port flag (recommended: press Enter for "auto"), and whether to use the author's color theme. After the install, the plugin panel is in the "Plugins" menu at the top right of Antigravity, under the name "agy-zh". To change the color theme, run `配色开关` (color toggle). To uninstall, run `一键卸载` (uninstall). Keep the extracted folder. ## Defaults | Feature | Default | Changes what is sent to Google? | |---|---|---| | Chinese UI translation | On | No. It only changes the local display | | Usage status bar | On | No. It only reads local data | | Author's color theme | Off | No. It only changes the theme colors of your local Antigravity | | Online updates of the dictionary and prices | On | No. Every 6 hours it asks GitHub for the latest commit of this project, then downloads the dictionary and price table from this project's GitHub repository (through jsDelivr). These are plain download requests; no data is uploaded. You can turn it off; see [Online updates](#online-updates) | | Version updates (code) | Only when you click "更新" (update) | No. Before it installs, it checks the signature with the author's public key; see [Version updates](#version-updates) | | Start without the debugging port | Windows: ask you; macOS: as chosen at install | No. It only closes Antigravity and opens it again with the flag; see [Without the debugging port flag](#without-the-debugging-port-flag) | Zoom, font and contrast are never changed. ## Features ### Chinese UI translation Menus, settings, buttons and hints are shown in Chinese (a dictionary of 3469 entries and 111 regex rules). Conversation content, code and file names are not translated. From v2.0.7, when a text made of several sentences (for example a description and a retirement date in the model menu) is not in the dictionary, it is split at the periods and translated sentence by sentence. It is shown in Chinese only if each sentence has a translation. From v2.0.8, the Swarm panel of Antigravity (a separate plugin frame) is also translated: tabs, states, counts and filters are shown in Chinese, and the goal, task titles and messages written by the agents stay as written. Some things are not translated on purpose: - **Names of Antigravity features**: Artifact, Turbo, Coordinator and Swarm stay in English (for example "Turbo 模式", "Artifact 评论"), so that they match the official docs and the community and are easy to search. Terms such as MCP, URL, SSH and token also stay in English. - **Names that you or third parties give**: conversation titles, project names, files and paths, automation names, Coordinator names, branch / repository / worktree names, SSH hosts, plugin titles and MCP server names are not translated, even when they are the same as a dictionary word. - **Single words that change meaning without context**: for example Plan (it can mean a subscription plan or a work plan), Type and Space stay in English when they stand alone. - **Error messages** are translated, and the original English text shows when you hold the mouse over them, so you can search for it or report it. #### Switch back to English From v2.0.8, press `Ctrl+Alt+E` (`Ctrl+Option+E` on macOS) to show the whole page in English, for example to compare with the official documentation. Press it again to switch back to Chinese. All windows and the Swarm panel switch together. A reload switches back to Chinese, and no setting is changed. The "运行状态" (status) section of the plugin panel also has a "现在切换" (switch now) button. AltGr+E (used for € on some European keyboards) does not switch. #### Untranslated UI text From v2.0.7, UI text that has no translation is recorded in `i18n-missing.json` in the data folder. The "没翻译的界面文字" (untranslated UI text) section of the plugin panel shows the count. You can expand it to see the latest 30 items, or clear the list. - The file stays on your computer. It is not uploaded. - The plugin does not record paths, URLs, email addresses, file names, model names and single code-like words. Texts that are different only in their numbers are recorded as one item (for example "Retry in 5 seconds" and "Retry in 12 seconds"). But names shown in the UI, such as project names and conversation titles, can be recorded. - To help with the dictionary, you can paste the UI text from the file into a GitHub issue of this project (remove names that you do not want to make public first). - A name that must stay in English is written in the dictionary with the same text as the translation (for example `"Swarm": "Swarm"`). Then it is not recorded again. #### Status bar only (no translation) Delete `i18n/zh-CN.json` in the plugin folder (see [What the installer does](#what-the-installer-does)), then press `Ctrl+R` (`Cmd+R` on macOS) once in Antigravity. The UI goes back to English and the status bar stays. The "文件" (files) line in the plugin panel then shows that 1 file does not match the signed manifest; this is expected. A reinstall or a version update puts the file back. ### Usage status bar Two fixed lines above the input box. Each item is a colored icon with text in the same color. Like ccline, the status bar text is in English. Hover over any item to see a detailed tooltip (in Chinese). You can change the colors and the style; see [Look](#look). | Line | Example | Meaning | |---|---|---| | Line 1 | `gemini-flash-worker-agy` | Model: the name in the UI, plus the model name that the API actually returns. For Gemini models, it turns yellow when the two do not match | | | `89% · 456k · ↻3×` | Context: the icon is a ring that fills as the context fills, then percent used and tokens used. If the conversation was auto-compacted, a small pale-yellow badge follows; the number is how many times. The tooltip shows the limit, a bar, the tokens and percent of each part that Antigravity reports, the free space, and at which steps it was compacted. From v2.0.8, click the badge to open the compaction viewer (see "Compaction viewer" below) | | | `99% hit` | Cache: the cache hit ratio of the last call; the tooltip shows how many tokens were read from cache | | | `$17.81` | Total cost of this conversation (subagents included). Hover to see the input, cache and output tokens of the last call and the cost of each. From v2.0.8, when the last call cost $0.50 or more, a small red badge follows (for example `!$1.82`; it flashes when it first shows). Its hover text gives the cache hit ratio of that call, how much the cache would have saved, and the usual causes | | | `$17.85 today` | Total cost today (from local midnight, all conversations). Click it to open the [daily usage panel](#daily-usage-panel) | | | `running` | The model is generating. When it is not generating, this item keeps an empty space, so the bar does not wrap and jump when generation starts or stops. In a narrow window this item gets smaller first, so it does not move to the next line | | Line 2 | `6.9s` | Time to first token | | | `169 tok/s` | Output speed | | | `0% · 16:44` | 5-hour limit: percent used (with a bar) and reset time | | | `41% · Sat 16:08 · ↑15%` | Weekly limit: percent used, reset time, and how far ahead (↑) or behind (↓) an even pace you are | | Subagents | `├ research · Paper Reviewer … ● 1m05s` | Each subagent gets its own line, joined in a tree with `├` and `└`; the columns of these lines are aligned. The items are: subagent type and task, model, context, cache hit, the cost of this subagent only, and status. The status is `● time running`, `● waiting` (it waits for your approval) or `✓ done time · N steps`; hover to see its current step and its last steps. The line closes about 10 seconds after the subagent ends. In a subagent window, the bar shows that subagent's own data | The look follows the cometix theme of [CCometixLine](https://github.com/Haleclipse/CCometixLine) (ccline, a status line for Claude Code) by Haleclipse: two lines, colored icons with text in the same color, `|` between items, `·` between numbers in one item, and bars for the limits. This project does not use ccline code. The status bar was written again for Antigravity. #### Look Click `$x today` to open the [daily usage panel](#daily-usage-panel), then click `theme` at the top right. At the top is a gallery of color palettes. Each card is a live copy of your status bar; click a card to use that palette. The other options are below it. A change applies at once. | Option | Values | Default | |---|---|---| | Palette | Cometix, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Rosé Pine, Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula, Mono | Cometix (this project's own palette) | | Style | `plain`: text with vertical-line separators; `pill`: a rounded background for each item; `powerline`: arrow-shaped color blocks | `plain` | | Bars (limits) | `thin`: a thin bar; `cells`: 10 cells; `ring`: a small ring; `none`: no bar | `thin` | | Detail | `compact`: no context limit, cache shows only the hit ratio; `full`: context with limit, cache with tokens read | `compact` | | Icons | `material`: filled icons; `outline`: line icons; `unicode`: plain characters (no online icon font); `off`: no icons | `material` | | Swap (per item) | Each item has one alternative icon. Click to switch between the default and the alternative. For example, the model can use a comet, and the output speed can use a 3-step gauge (the needle points to slow / medium / fast: below 30, 30 to 60, above 60 tok/s) | All default icons | - Each palette has a light and a dark version. The version follows the light or dark theme of Antigravity. The colors come from the published definitions of each palette (see [Credits](#credits)). Nord has only an official dark version, so its light version uses darker forms of the pale colors. - Your choice is kept in `look.json` in the data folder. The plugin saves it within 30 seconds and sends it to the other windows. To go back to the defaults, click `reset` at the top right of the Theme page, or close Antigravity and then delete the file. - The layers (palette, style, bar glyphs, detail) and the "gauge instead of icon" idea (the context icon is a ring that fills) follow ccline v2. This project does not use ccline code. #### Daily usage panel Click `$x today` in the status bar. A panel opens above the status bar. It is as wide as the input box and uses all the height above the status bar. Click it again, click outside the panel, or press `Esc` to close it. At the top right are the signed-in account (the email is masked, for example `ab***12@gmail.com · Ultra`) and the `theme` button, which opens the [Look](#look) settings. - **Top cards**: today's cost, calls, total tokens and cache hit ratio. - **Bar chart**: the estimated cost of each day in the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or all days (`all`, from v2.0.5: from the first day with records to today, up to 400 days; with more than 62 days, each bar is one week), with one color for each model. Hover over a bar to see that day's details. - **Table**: one row for each day, with cost, conversations, calls, total tokens, input / cache / output tokens, cache hit ratio, and how many percentage points of the weekly limit were used that day (Gemini group and Claude group separately). - **Call details** (from v2.0.8, the cost cell of a call of $0.50 or more is red with "!"; hover to see the cache hit ratio and likely causes, and the total next to the title gives how many such calls there are; on the author's computer, 93% of these calls had a cache miss; from v2.0.9, the hit cell of a call with a cache miss is yellow, its hover text gives the missed tokens, the extra cost and the cause, the total next to the title shows `miss +$X`, `all calls | cache misses` shows only these calls, and the per-conversation view has a `Miss` column; see "Cache misses" below): click a day in the table to see each model call of that day (today or an earlier day): time, conversation, model, cost, input, output, cache read, cache write, hit ratio, output speed, time to first token and total time. The newest call is at the top. The first 600 rows are listed, and `show 600 more` / `show all` below the table shows more; the totals include all calls. Missed tokens = the smaller input of the two calls − the cache read of this call; less than 20k missed tokens is not counted. Extra cost = missed tokens × (full input price − cache read price); for Claude, a miss writes the content to the cache, so the cache write price is used. The cause is found in the order of the table: | Cause | Shown as | Rule | | --- | --- | --- | | Model change | `model switch` | The first call of this model in the conversation, and the last large call used another model (the cache of the new model is empty) | | Compaction | `compaction` | A compaction step is between the two calls, or the input is more than 40% smaller than before | | You waited | `your pause` | 1 minute or more after the end of the last call, and you sent a message between them | | Pause in a turn | `agent pause` | 1 minute or more, and no message from you between them (a long command, waiting for your approval, waiting for a subagent) | | Pause (agy CLI) | `pause` | agy CLI calls have no step data, so it is not known whether you sent a message between them | | Other | `other` | Less than 1 minute after the end of the last call (the server did not use its cache, or the earlier content changed) | The limits come from 4143 calls on the author's computer from 11-17 to 11-24: when two calls in a conversation are less than 30 seconds apart, the Gemini cache hit ratio is 90% to 95%; at 2 to 5 minutes, 59% of the Hydrogen calls and 41% of the Carbon calls had no cache hit at all; the Claude cache stops after about 5 minutes (few samples). If a new period starts during the day, the parts are added. The reason: in one period the used ratio goes up and down (in one test, it went from 1.699% to 1.594% in 6 minutes while the model was generating). v1.4.x added only the increases, so an increase after a drop was counted again and the daily number was too high. After you upgrade to v1.5.0, earlier weekly records are calculated again with the new method. From v2.0.4, each period is recorded as a separate part. When a limit is reset, the readings sometimes go back to the old period once (seen on 2026-11-24); the plugin then continues that old part and does not count the old period's usage again as new usage (that day was recorded as 14.84%; the correct number was 7.06%). After the upgrade, days that the readings in `quota-samples.json` cover completely are calculated again once. - Limit used while Antigravity is closed (for example with the agy CLI) is counted on the next day that the plugin sees it. - The limit belongs to the account. So that a new version is not needed each time, the plugin downloads a few data files from this project's GitHub repository every 6 hours: | File | Contents | Updated by | |---|---|---| | `i18n/zh-CN.json`, `i18n/zh-CN.rules.json` | Dictionary and rules | The author pushes new translations | | `data/prices.json` | The price of each model | GitHub Actions checks the official pricing pages of Google AI Studio and Vertex AI every day and commits only when a price changes (`tools/update-prices.mjs`) | | `data/meta.json` | The latest version number | Changed at each release | - **Only data is downloaded here.** The dictionary and rules are only put into the UI as text (not as HTML), and prices are only numbers. Code updates are installed only when you click in the plugin panel; see [Version updates](#version-updates). - **The download uses Antigravity's own network.** The requests go out from the Antigravity page, with Antigravity's network and proxy settings, without cookies or a Referer. The addresses are tried in this order: `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, `fastly.jsdelivr.net`, `gcore.jsdelivr.net`, `raw.githubusercontent.com`. The last address that worked is tried first. - **Downloads by commit.** The plugin first asks GitHub (`api.github.com`) for the latest commit on the main branch, then downloads all files at that commit. Files at a commit do not change, so every address gives the same, current content. If GitHub cannot be reached (for example, because of a rate limit), the plugin gets `data/meta.json` from all addresses and uses the address with the newest content. v2.0.1 and earlier downloaded only by branch, so when one jsDelivr node had an old cache, the plugin could get an old dictionary and miss the new version notice for hours; v2.0.2 fixes this. - **Files are checked before use.** A file with a bad format, with more than 20% fewer entries than the bundled one (for example, a partial download), or with prices out of range is not used; the old data stays. After a failure, the plugin tries again in 30 minutes. - Online dictionary entries replace bundled entries with the same text; the other bundled entries stay. If you deleted the bundled dictionary (status bar only), the online dictionary is not used either. Models in the online price table use the online price; other models use the built-in price. - Text whose translation changed is updated at once; entries that are no longer in the online dictionary go back to English. - The downloaded files are kept in `remote/` in the data folder and are used again after Antigravity restarts. After you install a new version, the saved dictionary is not used until the next download (about 1 minute after the plugin starts). v1.7.0 had a bug: after a restart, the saved price table and version info could not be read until the next download (up to 6 hours). v2.0 fixes it. - **To turn it off**: plugin panel → 在线更新 → set "词典和价格" (dictionary and prices) to "关闭" (off); or daily usage panel → `theme` → `updates` at the bottom → `off`. Click "更新" (update) in the plugin panel: 1. The plugin downloads the signed manifest `plugin-manifest.json` from the tag of that version (`@v` on jsDelivr, with raw.githubusercontent.com as a fallback) and checks its Ed25519 signature with the author's public key in the plugin. When all files match, it backs up the current files to `backup/v/` in the data folder, then replaces the files one by one. If a replacement fails, it restores the backup. 4. If the backend changes the text, these places show English until the dictionary is updated. ## How it works - The plugin is `plugin.json` plus one sidecar (`sidecars/core/sidecar.json`) in the plugin folder. When the Antigravity backend (`language_server`) finds the plugin, it starts the sidecar (`sidecars/core/main.mjs`) on the Node that comes with Antigravity. If the sidecar exits, it is started again after about 1 to 2 seconds; if the plugin folder is deleted, it is stopped. - The sidecar runs the injector `inject.mjs`. Every 3 seconds it checks the Antigravity debugging port (the port number is in the `DevToolsActivePort` file that Antigravity writes). When it finds the main window, it injects the translator and the status bar script through the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It does not change the Antigravity install files, so it keeps working after Antigravity updates itself. Only one injector works at a time (a local single-instance lock). - The sidecar also serves the plugin panel (`lib/panel.mjs`, on `127.0.0.1` only), the reopen on a start without the flag (`lib/relaunch.mjs`), and version updates (`lib/update.mjs`). - Reopen: the sidecar is a child process of Antigravity, so it stops when Antigravity closes. A script that runs apart from Antigravity does the reopen. On Windows it is `relaunch-antigravity.ps1` in the data folder, started through Explorer (or WMI if that fails). On macOS it is a shell script that runs in the background with `nohup`. The script asks Antigravity to close, ends it if it is still running after 10 seconds, and opens it again with `--remote-debugging-port=0`. Each step goes into `relaunch.log`. - The status bar wraps `fetch` in the page and listens to the grpc-web+json data between the app and the local backend. It does not change the requests that the app sends. It also calls a few read-only local APIs: quota, the signed-in account (email and plan; the email is used only in the page to make the account ID and the masked text, and is not written to a file), the actual model name, subagent status and steps, and the token usage and time of each call (for the cost and the call details). - Every 30 seconds, the injector saves today's cost from the page into `cost-day.json`.
